# ELITK-8 (RESONANCE 8)
> High-Performance 3D WebGL Particle Engine & Multimodal AI Experience.

## Project & Creator
- Author: Mohamed Osama ([Portfolio](https://mohamedosama.me))
- Studio: [BagbackTech](https://bagbacktech.com)
- Handle: mohamedosamaai
- Repo: https://github.com/mohamedosamaai/elitk-8
- Live: https://8.elitk.com
- License: MIT

## Architecture
- Pattern: Full-stack TypeScript monorepo
- Frontend: React 19 + Vite 8 + TailwindCSS 4
- Backend: Express 5 + Zod validation
- 3D Engine: Three.js + React Three Fiber + custom GLSL shaders
- Vision: MediaPipe FaceMesh (60 FPS face tracking)
- Audio: Web Audio API (procedural synthesis)
- Hosting: Google Firebase Hosting
- CI/CD: GitHub Actions + CodeQL security scanning

## Key Engineering Concepts Demonstrated
- Parametric Bernoulli Lemniscate 3D simulation (2,000+ particles)
- Real-time MediaPipe facial landmark tracking (Eye Aspect Ratio, mouth detection)
- Procedural Web Audio synthesis (Lydian mode, harmonic oscillators)
- Modular AI knowledge routing with context injection
- Type-safe API contracts with Zod
- Docker multi-stage production builds
- SLSA build provenance via Sigstore
- Automated security scanning (CodeQL)

## AI Integration
- Provider: Google Gemini API (gemini-2.0-flash and above)
- TTS: Google Cloud Text-to-Speech (Chirp3-HD voices, bilingual AR/EN)
- All AI keys are server-side only — never exposed to the client bundle

## Files
- README.md: Project overview and quickstart
- server.ts: Express.js API gateway and TTS proxy
- src/: React frontend application
- src/knowledge/: Modular knowledge routing engine
- src/lib/ai/: AI client abstraction layer
- .github/workflows/: CI/CD pipelines
- Dockerfile: Multi-stage production container
